summary: Narrow York Street kerb with homes and apartments 4-7 m away along its whole length.
reasons: Narrow lane, little room to pull off

best_section.where: Bend in York Street, beside the apartment block's side

drivers.seclusion: Dwellings at 4, 6, 7 and 7 m line the east side; apartments overlook the bend.
drivers.access_and_room: Narrow sealed street with trees and fences close to the edge; no clear pull-off beside the lane.
drivers.traffic: Quiet residential street; few cars seen parked.
drivers.convention: No sign of campers; a few residents' cars park nearby.

sun_shade: Heavy tree and building shade from the west and south; patchy morning sun.
